newsitem.title: UK: UK parliament committee considering BoE role.
newsitem.headline: UK parliament committee considering BoE role.

text.p: Parliament's Treasury Committee said on Friday it was considering how it could best perform its formal role of holding the Bank of England accountable to Parliament now the BoE is operationally independent.

The committee said in a statement it had received a letter from Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown on the topic, but was now also seeking information on how similar roles were performed by committees of legislators in the United States and New Zealand.
The committee invited anyone interested in the field to make short submissions to it by August 27.
